step.goal: Detect test ecosystem and project structure
step.action: Scan project for: - package.json / requirements.txt / build files - Existing test directories and files - Test framework dependencies (jest, vitest, pytest, mocha, etc.) - E2E framework dependencies (playwright, cypress, selenium) - CI/CD configuration with test stages - Existing coverage configuration

Detect the tech stack: - Language(s): JavaScript/TypeScript, Python, Go, Java, etc. - Framework(s): React, Next.js, Express, Django, FastAPI, etc. - Database(s): PostgreSQL, MongoDB, etc. - API type: REST, GraphQL, gRPC
step.output:
## Test Ecosystem Detection
- **Language:** {{language}} - **Framework:** {{framework}} - **Test Framework:** {{test_framework}} ({{detected_or_recommended}}) - **E2E Framework:** {{e2e_framework}} ({{detected_or_recommended}}) - **Existing Tests:** {{existing_test_count}} files - **Current Coverage:** {{current_coverage}}%

step.goal: Define test pyramid and coverage targets
step.action:
Design the test pyramid for this project:
Unit Tests (base): - Target: {{unit_percentage}}% of total tests - Coverage target: {{unit_coverage}}% line coverage - Scope: Individual functions, methods, components - Speed: < 10ms per test
Integration Tests (middle): - Target: {{integration_percentage}}% of total tests - Coverage: API endpoints, service interactions, DB queries - Scope: Component interactions, API contracts - Speed: < 500ms per test
E2E Tests (top): - Target: {{e2e_percentage}}% of total tests - Coverage: Critical user journeys only - Scope: Full system workflows - Speed: < 30s per test

For each major feature/module in the architecture: - Identify which test types are needed - Estimate test count per category - Identify test data requirements - Identify mocking/stubbing needs - Identify external dependency handling

Specify test infrastructure: - Test database strategy (in-memory, test containers, shared) - Mock/stub strategy (MSW, nock, unittest.mock, etc.) - Test fixtures and factories - CI test parallelization - Test environment variables - Snapshot testing policy

Document test quality rules: - Naming conventions (describe/it, test_, Given/When/Then) - Assertion best practices (one logical assertion per test) - Test isolation requirements (no shared state between tests) - Flaky test policy (quarantine, fix within N days) - Test review requirements (part of code review) - Performance test thresholds (max test suite time)
Compile all sections into the template
